notes: Inputs of the ADR-0265 hypothesis documents (Amendment 5), read by index_options.theta_hypotheses: where the stores are, the snapshot pins of the registered inputs and the frozen universe. The two panel pins are 64 zeros until the panel is built and registered (`set-pin`): a document with a zero pin refuses at run time, which is the point. `universe` is a placeholder name until the census has run and `freeze-universe` has written configs/theta-universe.json: a chain reader asked for that name finds no root and refuses. Bar pins are the committed snapshots of the Yahoo daily-bar pulls (stock-daily-bars: the latest of three identical 233-file snapshots; stock-daily-bars-300; benchmark-daily-bars). Never edit by hand except through the CLI.
